# Splice Property Solutions

> Splice Property Solutions helps people move to, invest in, and retire in Cyprus with on-the-ground guidance from Tiffany Grimley and the local team.

Splice is a Cyprus property and relocation firm based on the island. It supports individuals, families, retirees, and investors from first enquiry through purchase and settling in. Core focus areas: residency and relocation practicalities, residential and commercial property investment, retirement living, and a concierge service that vets vendors and reduces scam risk. Tiffany Grimley personally reviews enquiries and works with clients directly.

Key facts:
- Business: Cyprus property solutions, relocation, and investment advisory
- Founder: Tiffany Grimley
- Location: Cyprus (on-the-ground team)
- Audience: people relocating, investing, or retiring in Cyprus
- Contact: https://www.splicepropertysolutions.com/enquire
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/tiffany-grimley-923215377/

## Services

- [Home](https://www.splicepropertysolutions.com/): Overview of moving, investing, and retiring in Cyprus with Splice on the ground from first question to keys.
- [Moving to Cyprus](https://www.splicepropertysolutions.com/moving): Relocation guide covering residency, tax, healthcare, schools, cost of living, and settling in.
- [Investing in Cyprus](https://www.splicepropertysolutions.com/investing): Property investment routes across residential, commercial, and hospitality with buying-process guidance.
- [Retiring to Cyprus](https://www.splicepropertysolutions.com/retiring): Retirement guide covering climate, healthcare, community, cost of living, and lifestyle.
- [The Splice Concierge](https://www.splicepropertysolutions.com/concierge): On-the-ground support with vetted vendors, scam protection, and local presence after arrival.
